'''Qualtrough''' was a terrestrial<ref name="PotJS" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Qualtrough system/Legends|Qualtrough system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its native population was at one point engaged in an intense worldwide [[Qualtrough civil war|civil war]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The planet was first discovered by the wider [[galactic community]]<ref name="CSWE" /> at some point between [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] and [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'' establishes that the truce negotiation on Qualtrough occurred during the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''{{'s}} first [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of service. {{FactFile|95|CHU 1-2|''Chu'unthor''}} dates the beginning of the [[Praxeum ship/Legends|starship's]] service to [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]]<ref name="PotJS" /> [[Praxeum ship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' arrived there. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] negotiated a truce between Qualtrough's conflicting parties<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;an accomplishment that attracted the attention of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Media/Legends|media]]<ref name="PotJS" /> and allowed the planet's inhabitants to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qualtrough was first mentioned in the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'', a [[2002]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PotJS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Qualtrough [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
